The test image shows a whole corn plant with pronounced yellow-green striping along the leaves — classic viral mosaic/streak pattern. Top candidates: Maize_Streak_Virus, Maize_Dwarf_Mosaic_Virus, Stewart_S_Disease, Maize_Chlorotic_Dwarf_Virus, Corn_Stunt_Spiroplasma.

I need to view 16 references across 16 classes. Starting with Maize_Streak_Virus.
Maize_Streak_Virus shows orange-yellow streaks — test image has lighter yellow-green streaking. Next: Maize_Dwarf_Mosaic_Virus.
MDMV shows subtle mosaic — less pronounced than test image. Next: Stewart_S_Disease.
Stewart's shows bleached tan streaks — different from test image's diffuse yellow-green pattern. Next: Maize_Chlorotic_Dwarf_Virus.
MCDV shows yellow spots/patches. Test image has linear yellow-green streaking. Next: Corn_Stunt_Spiroplasma.
Corn_Stunt shows purple/brown discoloration — very different. Next: Crazy_Top.
Crazy_Top shows stunted narrow leaves without yellow streaking. Next: Common_Rust.
Common_Rust shows dark pustules — completely different. Next: Gray_Leaf_Spot.
Gray_Leaf_Spot shows tan rectangular lesions — not matching. Next: Goss_S_Wilt.
Goss_S_Wilt shows brown lesions with freckles — not matching. Next: Northern_Leaf_Blight.
NLB shows cigar-shaped tan lesions — not matching. Next: Tar_Spot.
Tar_Spot shows black raised dots — not matching. Next: Eyespot.
Eyespot shows small circular spots — not matching. Next: Holcus_Spot.
Holcus_Spot shows isolated oval spots — not matching. Next: Carbonum_Leaf_Spot.
Carbonum shows small brown spots along veins — not matching. Next: Anthracnose_Leaf_Spot.
Anthracnose shows tan lesions — not matching. Final reference (16th): Southern_Rust.

Southern_Rust shows orange pustules — completely different.

**Summary of all 16 references viewed:**
- Maize_Streak_Virus: orange-yellow linear streaks (too orange vs test's yellow-green)
- Maize_Dwarf_Mosaic_Virus: light green/yellow mosaic on young leaves — closest color match
- Maize_Chlorotic_Dwarf_Virus: yellow vein banding patches — somewhat similar but more blotchy
- Stewart_S_Disease: bleached tan streaks — different
- All others (Common_Rust, Gray_Leaf_Spot, Goss_S_Wilt, NLB, Tar_Spot, Eyespot, Holcus_Spot, Carbonum, Anthracnose, Crazy_Top, Corn_Stunt, Southern_Rust): completely different patterns

**Decision:** The test image shows young corn plants with diffuse yellow-green streaking/mottling along the leaf veins. This matches Maize_Dwarf_Mosaic_Virus best — described as "narrow, light green to yellow streaks along leaf veins" progressing to mosaic. The color (yellow-green, not orange) rules out Maize_Streak_Virus, and the linear streaking pattern is more consistent with MDMV than the blotchy vein banding of MCDV.
